Salman Khan Addresses Trolling and Body Shaming on Bigg Boss 20

During an episode of Bigg Boss 20, Salman Khan addressed online trolling and body shaming directed at actors, including Katrina Kaif, Varun Dhawan, and Sohail. Khan expressed his disapproval of such behavior, stating, "That is wrong." He also appeared to lose his temper on the show, with one report noting he "LOSES Cool On Weekend Ka Vaar." Other reports from DNA mentioned unrelated news about Imran Khan's release demand and Aleema Khan's arrest, as well as Salman Khan's health scares, including a heart attack and cardiac arrest, and explanations for his bald look and a viral promo for Bigg Boss 20.
